# Sextant ecosystem index

The fastest path from a question to the page that answers it. Generated from the
tree by `scripts/ecosystem_index.py`; run `just session-start` to check it.

## Decisions

- [ADR-0001: Sextant is built only from SOTA sources](docs/adr/0001-sextant-foundation.md) — The earlier campaign measured 8,393 tracked files, about 71 KB of rules per session, 17 hook entries, 108 deny rules, 1,130 open beads and 64 open PRs (northstar...
- [ADR-0002: Rank, enter early, protect and re-enter across the trading lanes](docs/adr/0002-philosophy-and-lanes.md) — US equities are the trading focus. Research feeds replay, sim and paper; measured merit informs live promotion. The philosophy seeks small bounded planned losses and larger...
- [ADR-0003: Rank potential movers from their first prints and primary catalysts](docs/adr/0003-ranking-and-feeds.md) — Discovery must find US equity movers before a late spike, in every supported session. Ranking supplies entry candidates; it does not establish eligibility, fills or an economic...
- [ADR-0004: Enter the first rising leg and size every entry from its risk](docs/adr/0004-entry.md) — An early, qualified US equity entry must remain protectable within the order budget. Buying an extended spike or sizing from dwindling buying power defeats that purpose.
- [ADR-0005: Protect from the first fill, lock gains and sell on a persisted breach](docs/adr/0005-exit-engine.md) — Protect every fresh or adopted holding from its first fill, in every supported session. The managed fast sell is primary; the venue stop covers outages. One account-bound multi-...
- [ADR-0006: Re-enter on a confirmed reclaim or rotate after proven flatness](docs/adr/0006-reentry-and-rotation.md) — A fast protective sell can forfeit the rest of a mover's run. Re-entry must earn its extra round trips, preserve custody and use a current rank.
- [ADR-0007: Owner orders stay untouched and each account has one order writer](docs/adr/0007-custody-and-order-writing.md) — Owner entries need prompt protection without surrendering their orders to the house. REST answers, stream events, restarts and writer changes must preserve custody and possible-...
- [ADR-0008: Alpaca executes today; IBKR earns each additional role through paired evidence](docs/adr/0008-broker-roles.md) — US-equity lanes share one engine and keep broker accounts, execution and ownership distinct. Broker paper compares simulators; it cannot establish live execution quality or...
- [ADR-0009: Preserve the owner's limits and pace every outbound request below capacity](docs/adr/0009-order-rate-limits.md) — The owner's limits are **1000/minute Alpaca live, 200/minute per Alpaca paper account, and 3000/minute IBKR paper and live**. - [ADR-0010: Retain the guard and shared pacer while paper observes house safeguards](docs/adr/0010-risk-guard-pacing-and-halt.md) — The engine's Python surface cannot provide the complete kill, custody and request-pacing policy. The accepted composition retains owner control and broker constraints while...
- [ADR-0011: Keep incumbent sizing and test auto-leverage only on independent trading evidence](docs/adr/0011-sizing-and-auto-leverage.md) — Leverage creates no edge. Halting small-cap movers need planned-risk, funding and gap evidence before a sizing challenger replaces the incumbent. Paper continues its incumbent...

## Lanes

- [Live lane](lanes/live/README.md) — **Charter.** The only place Sextant can reach a broker with real money, and only through one path: a merged `live` branch, a merge commit, the `promotion` record and...
- [Options lane](lanes/options/README.md) — **Charter.** Research and simulation only. Options data is a zero-weight factor: it may inform research, but it never moves a rank, an entry, an exit, a size or leverage. No...
- [Paper lane](lanes/paper/README.md) — **Charter.** The proving ground: recorded fills on real broker paper accounts earn merit, and paper is never gated by P&L, loss budgets or trade counts. Its hard lines still...
- [Research lane](lanes/research/README.md) — **Charter.** Read-only. Find, cite and freeze the methods Sextant may test: a NautilusTrader maintained example or a published, cited method, recorded with its licence, data...
- [Sim lane](lanes/sim/README.md) — **Charter.** Prove a rule before any broker sees it: replay recorded data as MODELED, then run the same strategy against a live feed as SIMULATED in a sandbox that owns its own...
- [TradingView lane](lanes/tradingview/README.md) — **Charter.** Display and owner-manual execution only. TradingView lists, alerts and Pine panes show what research and paper are doing; no TradingView data feeds a machine...
